title: Astrology Debunked in 1 minute
description:
Every natural force we know — light, sound, gravity, radio waves, heat — weakens with distance. The farther you move from the source, the weaker the effect. But astrology completely ignores this fundamental law of nature.

In this video, we show why astrology is a pseudoscience:

Mars is said to make some women manglik, but whether Mars is 56 million km away (closest) or 400 million km away (farthest), astrologers claim the effect is the same.

When astrology was invented, people didn’t know about aphelion and perihelion or even about Uranus, Neptune, or the Andromeda Galaxy. If distance doesn’t matter, then why don’t these faraway bodies affect us?

By simple logic, astrology collapses under its own contradictions.

If you’ve searched for “astrology debunked,” “why astrology is fake,” “manglik dosha explained,” “distance effect in astrology,” or “astrology pseudoscience”, this video gives you the rational perspective. Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share…

If you're interested in learning more about the evidence against astrology, then be sure to watch the four part series debunking astrology that I have made! I hope that after watching it, you'll have a better understanding of why astrology is not a reliable way to understand your life. Thanks for watching!
